theorems.name: Nonperiodic equal-slope/unbounded-debt separation
assumptions: actual schedule U^k V^k for successive k>=1
theorems.law: All six normalized Smith depths tend to1/2 while spread(k^2)=k and spread(k(k+1))=0. Hence equal mean slopes do not imply bounded anisotropy for variable products.
theorems.boundary: Not a counterexample to fixed-matrix powers or finite autonomous deterministic control.

theorems.name: Signed debt is an exact future-sufficient split-family carrier
assumptions: only the two declared commuting zero-offset matrices U,V
theorems.law: (t,d=u-v) reconstructs the entire linear action. Current Smith type alone loses the sign; states(t=4,d=+2/-2) have equal current type but next-U spreads3 and1.
theorems.boundary: No labeled-path recovery; extra affine or noncommuting operations require new proof.

theorems.name: Finite lattice-port uniform carry bound
assumptions: invertible rational basis S_c for each port
p^-k S_target^-1 A S_source and its inverse are p-integral on every allowed edge
theorems.law: Every legal path satisfies spread_p(A_path)<=kappa(S_start)+kappa(S_end), independently of length or selection policy. Scalar depth is sum of declared k labels.
theorems.boundary: Linear carry only; no affine displacement, mass, metric, temperature or semantic bound. Supplied-certificate failure is not nonexistence.

theorems.name: Common-lattice existence criterion for integral normalized mean
assumptions: v_p(det A_j)=6 k_j with integer k_j
all words observed, not merely almost-sure paths
theorems.law: Uniform bounded p-Smith spread over all words is equivalent to existence of a common full Z_p lattice invariant under every p^-k_j A_j.
theorems.boundary: Existence result, not a complete search algorithm. Fractional mean and constrained multi-port necessity not asserted.

theorems.name: Fair split branching retains growing mean-square debt
assumptions: independent equiprobable U,V choices at every tick
existing positive exact BRC branch semantics
theorems.law: Debt d has multiplicity C(t,(t+d)/2) with individual weight2^-t; E[d]=0 and E[spread^2]=E[d^2]=t.
theorems.boundary: Probability-model statement only; zero mean is not pathwise or quadratic balance.

theorems.name: Three-port repayment permits nonperiodic exact macro balance
assumptions: at debt0 choose U or V
at debt+1 force V; at debt-1 force U
theorems.law: All even-boundary linear actions are p^(t/2)I; odd-boundary spread=1. The lattice-port certificate uses S_d=diag(p^d I3,I3) and normalized edge maps I.
theorems.boundary: Actual restricted control policy; not a cost-free compression of unrestricted choices.
